text:
ops-bot: PAGING: p95/p99 latency SLO breach detected for tenant=HeliosBank on pool=helios-dedicated-ap-southeast (ap-southeast-1). p95 jumped 450ms -> 1.1s, p99 jumped 1.9s -> 4.6s. error-rate within baseline. alerting on-call.

elena: ack. i'm on it. creating bridge. putting incident channel in +focus. beth-cs, tag HeliosBank CS?

beth-cs: on it. opening customer bridge and flagging their ops contact. will ask for permission before any routing changes.

ryan: pulling traces and infra metrics. suspicion: high io wait on that node pool and a recent model push at 02:10 UTC. checking deploy logs.

infra-bot: Deploy event: models/helios-gpt-2.1.0 pushed to pool helios-dedicated-ap-southeast at 1764006000 by bot-deploy. rollout strategy: gradual 33% -> 66% -> 100%. No failures logged.

elena: if rollout aligns with spike timeline, let's pause further rollouts and pin to previous model for HeliosBank only. pause command?

oncall-runtime: pausing global rollout now and creating tenant pin.

oncall-runtime: ```
redwoodctl rollout pause --model models/helios-gpt-2.1.0
redwoodctl tenant pin --tenant HeliosBank --model models/helios-gpt-2.0.7
```

ryan: rollout paused. pin applied. telemetry shows p99 for pinned traffic improved slightly to 2.4s but still high.

arjun: I see massive KV cache churn and a spike in disk-backed kv-evictions around t-7m. cache hit dropped from 94% -> 58% for that pool. Could be model change with larger KV footprint.

elena: options: (A) route HeliosBank to a quantized smaller model helm-lite (quality regression risk), (B) scale pool (adds warm time), (C) temporarily throttle non-critical endpoints for the tenant, (D) split traffic to hosted-ap. What's fastest?

arjun: A and C fastest. Quantized route flip is instant config change. Throttling non-essential endpoints (e.g., embeddings only for batch jobs) can free capacity immediately.

beth-cs: HeliosBank allows emergency mitigations for up to 60 minutes per their escalation policy. They've requested status updates every 10 minutes.

ryan: running a smoke test to validate helm-lite on their most common prompt shapes.

oncall-runtime: prepping route patch for quick switch.``` 
# route switch
redwoodctl routes update --tenant HeliosBank --route default --model helm-lite-q2 --reason "mitigate p99 spike"
```

elena: go ahead with route switch and also enable a per-tenant throttling policy to deprioritize long-running generation tasks. set throttle to 0.5x token rate for non-interactive endpoints.

oncall-runtime: applying both now.

oncall-runtime: deploy-bot: Route update started. 0/4 warm replicas. Throttle policy applied: non-interactive rate=0.5x.

infra-bot: Node pool metric: average io wait 54% on nodes n-3 to n-5. One node showing repeated reclaim events. Suggest marking node n-4 unschedulable.

arjun: I'll cordon n-4 and trigger replacement.``` 
redwoodctl nodes cordon n-4 --pool helios-dedicated-ap-southeast
redwoodctl nodes replace n-4
```

ryan: after route switch: aggregated p95=380ms, p99=1.1s. Improvements immediate for routed traffic. dedicated-pool-only p99 still ~2.3s. Overall impact decreasing.

beth-cs: HeliosBank on bridge. They report some responses look slightly shorter but acceptable; they gave verbal OK to keep mitigation for 45 minutes and get a full RCA.

elena: great. continue monitoring. arjun, replace node and check eviction traces.

arjun: replacing node now. also triggered a targeted KV cache compact for the pool to free up memory pressure: ```
redwoodctl pool cache compact --pool helios-dedicated-ap-southeast
```

infra-bot: Node replace started. new node n-8 provisioning.

oncall-runtime: Warm update progress: routes/helios/default -> helm-lite-q2: 3/4 replicas warmed. Traffic is at 80% switched.

ryan: tracing shows long-tail attributable to a small subset of large-context prompts hitting the old model variant with no prefix caching. we can enable prefix caching for tenant as an intermediate optimization.

elena: enable prefix caching for HeliosBank tenant and keep monitoring. If p99 < 1s aggregated for 10m, we'll downgrade to monitored state.

oncall-runtime: enabling prefix caching flag for tenant.``` 
redwoodctl tenant config set --tenant HeliosBank --prefix-cache enabled
```

ryan: after prefix caching + route switch: aggregated p99 = 0.82s, p95 = 310ms. steady for 4 minutes.

elena: status update: MITIGATED -> service interactive quality preserved via helm-lite; dedicated pool impact reduced via node replacement and cache compact. Incident severity: SEV-2 (latency SLO breach). No errors, no data exposure. Customer notified.

beth-cs: confirming HeliosBank will want a remediation plan and to delay non-critical deploys for 48h. I've captured their ask.

arjun: action items: (1) reproduce cache churn with model 2.1.0 under synthetic large-context load, (2) add a pre-flight check on model rollout for estimated KV footprint, (3) add per-pool node health anomalous io-wait alert. I'll own RCA.

ryan: infra actions: add canary guard to abort kernel-level optimizations or memory-heavy flags on dedicated pools without explicit opt-in. I'll own that.

elena: handoff: ryan -> elena for overnight watch at +45m. I'll stay available until next update. please document all mitigation commands and attach to INC-2026-1987.

infra-bot: Incident recorded: INC-2026-1987 created by ops-bot.

elena: timeline notes for postmortem: 1764006000 model rollout started; 1764007500 first p95/p99 alert; 1764007900 mitigation started (route + throttle); 1764008200 node cordon + cache compact; 1764008400 p99 under 1s aggregated.

beth-cs: customer notified timeline and asked for a brief after-action tomorrow 09:00 local.

arjun: creating RCA ticket and linking to incident: RCA-2026-582. I'll include reproduction scripts, command snippets, and mitigation checklist (route-to-fallback, tenant throttle, prefix-cache, node-replace).

oncall-runtime: final check: traffic split remains 100% -> helm-lite-q2 for HeliosBank. Deciding next step: revert to original model only after validation in staging with kv size regression tests.

elena: agreed. we'll not unpin until rca and staging validation complete. handoff to elena for overnight. thanks all.

ops-bot: NOTE  Incident updated: status=mitigated, severity=SEV-2, incident=INC-2026-1987, responders=[elena,ryan,arjun,beth-cs,oncall-runtime].

elena: last_message_ts=1764008475. closing bridge. scheduling postmortem for 2026-03-16 11:00 UTC.
